title: Speculative Forcing for Efficient Autoregressive Video Generation
title_zh: 用于高效自回归视频生成的推测性强制机制

paragraphs.en: Few-step autoregressive video generators enable streaming generation, yet they run every token through the final denoising step, regardless of how much refinement it needs. We find this uniform computation is often unnecessary: many tokens already closely match their eventual full-step outputs in the initial steps, while others require refinement until the end. We introduce Speculative Forcing , a framework that treats intermediate clean estimates as drafts and predicts when individual tokens can be safely accepted early. Once accepted, a token is frozen as its final output and undergoes no further denoising, while its cached keys and values remain available as context for the remaining tokens. We explore two alternative verifier designs: a training-free one based on similarity to clean content and stability across steps, and a learned one that reads the frozen generator’s intermediate features to estimate each token’s remaining gap to its full-step output. Across short-video, long-video, and world generation, Speculative Forcing preserves the quality of full-step sampling while substantially reducing computation. On LongLive, it matches the four-step generator with ∼ \sim 1.7 denoising steps per token, running over 1.5 × 1.5\times faster at 41.7 and 37.8 fps. On Lingbot-World 2.0, where camera motion continually changes the visible content, it maintains quality with ∼ \sim 2.5 denoising steps per token and runs 1.35 × 1.35\times faster at 24.5 fps.
paragraphs.zh: 少步自回归视频生成器实现了流式生成，但它们会让每个 token 都经过最终的去噪步骤，而不管它需要多少精炼。 我们发现这种均匀计算往往是不必要的：许多 token 在最初的步骤中就已经非常接近它们最终的全步输出，而另一些 token 则需要精炼直到最后。 我们提出 Speculative Forcing，一个将中间干净估计视为草稿并预测单个 token 何时可以被安全地提前接受的框架。 一旦被接受，一个 token 会被冻结为其最终输出，不再进行进一步的去噪，而其缓存的键和值仍然可以作为其余 token 的上下文使用。 我们探索了两种替代性验证器设计：一种是无训练的，基于与干净内容的相似性以及跨步骤的稳定性；另一种是学习得到的，它读取冻结生成器的中间特征来估计每个 token 与其全步输出之间的剩余差距。 在短视频、长视频和世界生成任务中，Speculative Forcing 在保持全步采样质量的同时大幅减少了计算量。 在 LongLive 上，它以每 token 约 1.7 个去噪步骤达到了与四步生成器相当的效果，运行速度提升超过 1.5 倍，达到 41.7 和 37.8 fps。 在 Lingbot-World 2.0 上，相机运动持续改变可见内容的情况下，它以每 token 约 2.5 个去噪步骤保持质量，运行速度提升 1.35 倍，达到 24.5 fps。

paragraphs.en: Diffusion models have enabled high-quality image and video generation, with recent video models achieving realistic appearance, natural motion, and faithful prompt following ( Team Wan et al., 2025 ; Kong et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2025b ; NVIDIA et al., 2026 ; Team Seedance et al., 2026 ) . Autoregressive (AR) video generators extend these capabilities to streaming generation ( Yin et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2025a ; Liu et al., 2025b ; Zhu et al., 2026 ; Lu et al., 2025 ) and interactive world models ( Team et al., 2026 ; Gao et al., 2026 ; He et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026 ; Seo et al., 2026 ; AlayaWorld Team et al., 2026 ) . Within a video, however, different regions may require different amounts of refinement. Some may readily reproduce familiar content from the history, while others must form newly appearing structures or resolve fine details. This raises a fundamental question: Does every token need to be denoised until the final step?

paragraphs.en: We study this question in distilled few-step AR video generators, whose intermediate predictions can already serve as plausible video outputs. Self Forcing ( Huang et al., 2025 ) uses intermediate clean estimates as outputs for distribution-matching training ( Yin et al., 2024b ; Yin et al., 2024a ) , making them natural candidates for early commitment. We observe that many tokens already approximate the generator’s own full-step output in the initial steps, while others continue changing until the last step (Figure 2 ). These differences often follow intuitive patterns. Regions that reproduce previously observed content can settle early, while nearby regions continue refining appearance or motion. Similar variation arises in world models as actions change the observed content. These observations motivate a simple principle: stop denoising tokens once they have converged, and spend the remaining computation only where refinement is still needed.

paragraphs.en: We introduce Speculative Forcing , a framework that predicts when each token’s estimate has sufficiently converged, allowing individual tokens to be accepted at different steps (Figure 1 ). Each intermediate clean estimate serves as a draft of the generator’s full-step output. A verifier determines whether to accept the draft or continue refining it. Once accepted, the estimate is fixed as the token’s output and receives no further denoising updates, while retaining its cached keys and values as context for the remaining tokens. paragraphs.en: We address this challenge with two verifiers. Because drafts are clean latent estimates, similarity to previously generated content and changes between consecutive estimates of the same token provide evidence of convergence without additional training. Our training-free verifier uses similarity to clean history or reference content at the first step and stability between consecutive drafts at later steps. We also introduce a learned verifier for demanding settings such as world models, leveraging contextual cues encoded in the pretrained generator’s intermediate features. A shallow head trained with the generator frozen predicts each token’s gap to the full-step output, showing that the intermediate features contain cues about how much its predictions will change with further denoising. Both verifiers support token-wise acceptance without modifying the generator’s weights.

paragraphs.en: Autoregressive Video Generation. Autoregressive (AR) video diffusion models generate successive frames or chunks conditioned on preceding content ( ai et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2024a ) . Distribution matching distillation ( Yin et al., 2024b ; Yin et al., 2024a ) enables few-step generation by aligning the student’s output distribution with a target distribution represented by a pretrained teacher. CausVid applies distribution matching to distill a bidirectional teacher into a causal generator ( Yin et al., 2025 ) , while Self Forcing trains on autoregressive rollouts conditioned on the generator’s own outputs ( Huang et al., 2025 ) . Causal Forcing revisits this distillation for real-time interactive generation ( Zhu et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ) . LongLive, Rolling Forcing, and Self-Forcing++ extend few-step generation to long streaming videos ( Yang et al., 2025a ; Liu et al., 2025b ; Cui et al., 2025 ) . The same few-step AR recipe underlies real-time interactive world models, which additionally condition generation on actions or camera trajectories ( Team et al., 2026 ; Gao et al., 2026 ; He et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026 ; Seo et al., 2026 ; AlayaWorld Team et al., 2026 ) . These generators produce a clean latent estimate at every denoising step, not only the last, so an intermediate estimate can serve as a final output.

paragraphs.en: Adaptive Denoising. Caching methods accelerate diffusion by reusing intermediate computation across denoising steps ( Ma et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2024b ; Selvaraju et al., 2024 ; Zhao et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2025a ) , including reuse selected per token ( Zou et al., 2025 ) and, in AR video generation, per chunk or by local motion ( Ma et al., 2026 ; Xu et al., 2026 ) . Spatially adaptive samplers redistribute computation within the schedule, with RAS recomputing only the regions the model attends to ( Liu et al., 2026 ) and HSA evaluating each token at a different number of steps along the same noise schedule ( Chu and Patel, 2026 ) . In both cases every token is carried to the end of the schedule, so no token is ever declared finished, and the error left by the computation that was skipped has to be kept bounded by periodic full updates. Substituting a previous output also weakens as the schedule shortens, since distilled samplers leave fewer steps over which one output can stand in for the next ( Zou et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 自适应去噪。 缓存方法通过在去噪步骤之间复用中间计算来加速扩散模型（Ma et al., 2023；Chen et al., 2024b；Selvaraju et al., 2024；Zhao et al., 2025；Liu et al., 2025a），其中包括按每个 token 选择性复用（Zou et al., 2025），以及在自回归视频生成中按块或依据局部运动进行复用（Ma et al., 2026；Xu et al., 2026）。 空间自适应采样器在调度内重新分配计算量，其中 RAS 只重新计算模型所关注的区域（Liu et al., 2026），而 HSA 则让每个 token 在同一噪声调度上以不同数量的步数进行评估（Chu and Patel, 2026）。 在这两种情况下，每个 token 都会被推进到调度结束，因此没有任何 token 会被判定为已完成，而被跳过的计算所留下的误差必须通过周期性的完整更新来保持在有界范围内。 用前一步的输出进行替代的做法也会随着调度的缩短而变弱，因为蒸馏采样器留下的步骤更少，一个输出能代替下一步输出的余地也随之减少（Zou et al., 2026）。

paragraphs.en: In Self Forcing-style generators, DSA and Surprise Forcing select denoising depth for an entire frame or chunk, assigning the same number of steps to settled and unsettled regions ( Le et al., 2026 ; Shi et al., 2026 ) . Speculative Forcing instead treats intermediate clean estimates as drafts that can be committed at different steps according to token-wise convergence (Figure 2 ). It draws on draft verification in speculative decoding ( Leviathan et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2023 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ) , without adopting its exact acceptance rule. Committed tokens receive no further denoising updates, while their cached keys and values remain as context for the remaining tokens.

paragraphs.en: Autoregressive video diffusion. Autoregressive (AR) video diffusion models generate a video as a sequence of latent chunks { c 1 , c 2 , … } \{c_{1},c_{2},\dots\} , each containing one or more consecutive frames. The joint distribution is factorized as p ⁡ ( c 1 , c 2 , … ) = ∏ t p ⁡ ( c t ∣ c < t ) , p(c_{1},c_{2},\dots)=\prod_{t}p(c_{t}\mid c_{<t}), where each conditional distribution is modeled through a diffusion process. At inference, the model generates each chunk by progressively denoising Gaussian noise conditioned on previously generated chunks. We consider generators that use clean history ℋ t = c < t \mathcal{H}_{t}=c_{<t} as conditioning and cache its keys and values to avoid recomputing history features during subsequent generation.
paragraphs.zh: 自回归视频扩散。 自回归（AR）视频扩散模型将视频生成为一系列潜在块 { c 1 , c 2 , … } \{c_{1},c_{2},\dots\} ，每个块包含一帧或多帧连续帧。 联合分布被分解为 p ⁡ ( c 1 , c 2 , … ) = ∏ t p ⁡ ( c t ∣ c < t ) , p(c_{1},c_{2},\dots)=\prod_{t}p(c_{t}\mid c_{<t}), ，其中每个条件分布通过扩散过程建模。 在推理时，模型以先前生成的块为条件，通过对高斯噪声进行逐步去噪来生成每个块。 我们考虑使用干净历史 ℋ t = c < t \mathcal{H}_{t}=c_{<t} 作为条件的生成器，并缓存其键和值，以避免在后续生成中重复计算历史特征。

paragraphs.en: Few-step autoregressive generation. Distilled AR video generators ( Yin et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2025a ) reduce the denoising process to K K steps, enabling real-time streaming. Each chunk contains N N spatiotemporal latent tokens indexed by i i . At step k ∈ { 1 , … , K } k\in\{1,\dots,K\} , the generator takes the current noisy latent and the clean history as input and predicts a clean estimate x ^ 0 ( k ) \hat{x}_{0}^{(k)} . For k < K k<K , this estimate is re-noised to the next noise level for further denoising, and the final estimate x ^ 0 ( K ) \hat{x}_{0}^{(K)} is returned as the generated chunk.
paragraphs.zh: 少步自回归生成。 蒸馏式自回归（AR）视频生成器（Yin et al., 2025；Huang et al., 2025；Yang et al., 2025a）将去噪过程缩减为 K 步，从而实现实时流式生成。 每个分块包含 N 个由 i 索引的时空潜在词元。 在步骤 k ∈ {1, …, K} 时，生成器以当前带噪潜变量和干净历史作为输入，预测干净估计值 x̂₀⁽ᵏ⁾。 当 k < K 时，该估计值被重新加噪到下一个噪声水平以继续去噪，而最终估计值 x̂₀⁽ᴷ⁾ 则作为生成的分块返回。

paragraphs.en: Commitment and continued denoising. Every token starts active, and the first step produces a draft for every token. At each step k < K k<K , the verifier evaluates the active tokens. An accepted token i i has its output fixed to x ^ 0 ( k ) ​ ( i ) \hat{x}_{0}^{(k)}(i) and is excluded from all subsequent denoising forwards. Its layer-wise keys and values computed at commitment remain cached, allowing active tokens to continue attending to it. Rejected tokens are re-noised to the next noise level and continue denoising. Any tokens still active at step K K are committed at that step.

paragraphs.en: To make acceptance decisions before the full-step output is available, we seek evidence of convergence in the current draft and the features used to produce it. The draft can be compared with clean content or its own previous estimate, motivating a training-free verifier. The generator’s intermediate features provide additional contextual information, which a learned verifier uses to predict the convergence gap. Since latent tokens encode content across multiple output frames, isolated acceptance decisions can affect both spatial and temporal coherence. We therefore apply a spatiotemporal smoothing operator 𝒮 \mathcal{S} to each verifier’s scores before thresholding, encouraging coherent decisions across neighboring tokens.
paragraphs.zh: 为了在全步输出可用之前做出接受决策，我们在当前草稿及用于生成它的特征中寻找收敛的证据。 草稿可以与干净内容或其自身先前的估计进行比较，这促成了免训练验证器的动机。 生成器的中间特征提供了额外的上下文信息，学习型验证器利用这些信息来预测收敛差距。 由于潜在令牌对跨多个输出帧的内容进行编码，孤立的接受决策可能同时影响空间和时间一致性。 因此，我们在阈值判定之前对每个验证器的分数应用时空平滑算子 𝒮 \mathcal{S}，以促进相邻令牌之间决策的一致性。

paragraphs.en: Redundancy and stability are proxies for convergence rather than convergence itself. A token can match the history and still need refinement, or change little between two steps and yet remain far from its final value. The learned verifier instead predicts the convergence gap directly from the generator’s own features. A shallow convolutional head suffices for this prediction, indicating that the intermediate features contain information about each token’s remaining discrepancy to the full-step output.
paragraphs.zh: 冗余性和稳定性是收敛的替代指标，而非收敛本身。 一个词元可能与历史记录匹配但仍需细化，也可能在两步之间变化很小却离其最终值还很远。 学习到的验证器则直接根据生成器自身的特征来预测收敛差距。 一个浅层卷积头就足以完成这一预测，这表明中间特征包含了每个词元与整步输出之间剩余差距的信息。

paragraphs.en: Training. The head takes the hidden state of a selected backbone layer at step k k and outputs a predicted gap r ^ k ​ ( i ) \hat{r}_{k}(i) for each token. paragraphs.en: Experimental setups. We keep both generators frozen and evaluate training-free and learned verifiers. For LongLive, we train the learned verifier on full-step rollouts from 1K VidProM ( Wang and Yang, 2024 ) prompts following the generator’s original training rollout procedure. For Lingbot, we collect training rollouts from 1K initial images with scenes disjoint from evaluation, using the same random camera-trajectory sampling and rollout protocol as evaluation. paragraphs.en: We further evaluate Lingbot on 200 held-out navigation scenes to examine performance under substantial changes in visible content and pronounced intermediate distortions. Each scene provides an initial image, a text prompt, and a camera trajectory composed of five segments with randomly sampled camera actions and motion speeds. We generate 253 frames per scene and report a VBench quality aggregate over six dimensions, excluding temporal flickering. We also report relative camera-pose error against the commanded ground-truth trajectory to assess whether accelerated sampling follows the camera path as faithfully as the four-step generator. For both long videos and world model rollouts, we additionally report the Drift metric of Reward Forcing ( Lu et al., 2025 ) , which measures temporal variation in imaging quality across video segments. All methods share the same conditioning inputs and sampling seeds. Metric definitions and benchmark construction are detailed in Appendix B .

paragraphs.en: Effect of verification signals. We adapt two existing selection criteria to token-wise commitment in latent space. Inspired by MotionCache ( Xu et al., 2026 ) , we measure temporal differences between adjacent latent frames at the same spatial position. We also adapt RAS’s predicted-noise dispersion signal ( Liu et al., 2026 ) to the channel variance of each predicted clean latent token. Thresholds are calibrated on held-out data to obtain comparable mean denoising steps. As shown in Table 5 , both adapted signals yield lower quality than our learned verifier and uniform sampling at similar mean steps. Temporal differences, for example, can reflect both camera-induced changes and intermediate distortions, limiting their reliability as convergence signals (Figure 5 ). These results support directly predicting each draft’s remaining convergence gap.
paragraphs.zh: 验证信号的效果。 我们将两种现有的选择准则适配到潜空间中的逐词元承诺上。 受 MotionCache（Xu et al., 2026）启发，我们测量相同空间位置上相邻潜帧之间的时间差异。 我们还将 RAS 的预测噪声离散度信号（Liu et al., 2026）适配到每个预测的干净潜词元的通道方差上。 阈值在留出数据上进行校准，以获得可比的平均去噪步数。 如表 5 所示，在相近的平均步数下，两种适配后的信号的质量都低于我们学习得到的验证器与均匀采样。 例如，时间差异既可能反映相机引起的变化，也可能反映中间失真，这限制了其作为收敛信号的可靠性（图 5）。 这些结果支持直接预测每个草稿的剩余收敛差距。

paragraphs.en: Comparison with oracle verification. We additionally evaluate an oracle verifier that computes the full-step reference for each chunk using the same initial noise and conditioning, then uses the measured convergence gaps to determine token acceptance. We apply the same tolerance and spatiotemporal smoothing as the learned verifier. paragraphs.en: Effect of token-wise commitment. Adaptive denoising has been explored at frame and chunk granularity ( Le et al., 2026 ; Shi et al., 2026 ) . To isolate commitment granularity, we use the same learned verifier but accept an entire chunk when its mean predicted convergence gap falls below a threshold at each step. The threshold is calibrated on held-out data against the oracle criterion to match our mean denoising steps. As shown in Table 5 , token-wise commitment achieves higher quality and lower Drift at comparable mean denoising steps. Chunk-wise acceptance cannot distinguish tokens that have already converged from those that continue to change, resulting in lower quality and higher Drift when all tokens share the same acceptance step (Figure 5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 逐词（token）承诺的影响。 自适应去噪已在帧和块（chunk）粒度上得到探索（Le 等， 2026； Shi 等， 2026）。 为了隔离承诺粒度的影响，我们使用相同的已学习验证器，但当整块在每个步骤的平均预测收敛间隙低于阈值时才接受整块。 该阈值在留出数据上按与预言机（oracle）标准对比进行校准，以匹配我们的平均去噪步数。 如表 5 所示，逐词承诺在相近的平均去噪步数下实现了更高质量和更低的 Drift。 逐块接受无法区分已收敛的词元与仍在变化的词元，导致所有词元共享同一接受步骤时质量更低且 Drift 更高（图 5）。

paragraphs.en: We introduced Speculative Forcing , a framework that allocates denoising computation according to token-wise convergence in few-step autoregressive video generation. By treating intermediate clean estimates as drafts, it predicts which tokens can be accepted early and continues denoising only the remaining tokens. Training-free and learned verifiers enable these decisions without modifying the generator’s weights. Experiments on short and long videos and controllable world model rollouts demonstrate faster generation while maintaining quality, with comparable or lower quality variation and preserved camera-following accuracy in world modeling. These results show that a shared denoising depth is not necessary for every token, supporting convergence-based acceptance as a practical approach to efficient video generation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 Speculative Forcing，一个在少步自回归视频生成中根据逐 token 收敛情况分配去噪计算量的框架。 通过将中间的干净估计视为草稿，它预测哪些 token 可以提前接受，并仅对剩余的 token 继续去噪。 免训练的和经过学习的验证器使这些决策成为可能，而无需修改生成器的权重。 在短视频、长视频以及可控世界模型推演上的实验表明，该方法在保持质量的同时实现了更快的生成，质量波动相当或更低，并保留了世界建模中的镜头跟随精度。 这些结果表明，并非每个 token 都需要相同的去噪深度，支持将基于收敛的接受作为一种实用的视频生成加速方法。

paragraphs.en: We retain the released backbone configurations except for the denoising policies evaluated in this work. For LongLive ( Yang et al., 2025a ) , we use an attention sink of 3 latent frames, a local attention window of 12 latent frames, and 3 latent frames per chunk. Short and long videos contain 81 and 477 frames, respectively. For Lingbot-World 2.0 ( Gao et al., 2026 ) , we use the 1.3B Causal-Fast model with an attention sink of 6 latent frames, a local attention window of 18 latent frames, and 4 latent frames per chunk. We retain the original camera-conditioning pathway, including per-video translation normalization by the maximum translation magnitude. paragraphs.en: We retain the original denoising schedules so that early commitment operates on the intermediate clean estimates supervised during distribution-matching training. In our configurations, LongLive and Lingbot-World 2.0 share the shifted timesteps [ 1000.0,937.5,833.3,625.0 ] [1000.0,937.5,833.3,625.0] , obtained from a 1000-step flow-matching schedule with a shift of 5.0 5.0 . A token accepted at step k k undergoes exactly the first k k steps of this schedule. Uniform-step baselines use the same prefixes, allowing us to compare token-wise acceptance with a shared exit step along the same trained denoising trajectory.
paragraphs.zh: 我们保留原始的去噪调度，使早期提交作用于在分布匹配训练期间受到监督的中间干净估计。 在我们的配置中，LongLive 和 Lingbot-World 2.0 共享偏移后的时间步 [1000.0, 937.5, 833.3, 625.0]，该时间步由位移为 5.0 的 1000 步流匹配调度得到。 在第 k 步被接受的词元恰好经历该调度中的前 k 步。 均匀步基线使用相同的前缀，使我们能够在同一条训练好的去噪轨迹上，以共享的退出步来比较逐词元的接受情况。

paragraphs.en: The learned verifier reads hidden states from the generator’s final transformer block without an additional backbone forward. The head’s output is average-pooled over 2 × 2 × 2 2\times 2\times 2 token blocks and expanded back to the original grid using nearest-neighbor interpolation. The head has 4.11M parameters and is shared across denoising steps. We train only the head using the smooth- ℓ 1 \ell_{1} loss and Adam with a learning rate of 10 − 3 10^{-3} and batch size 4.

paragraphs.en: Within each chunk, accepted tokens retain the layer-wise keys and values computed at their acceptance step, while active tokens update theirs as denoising continues. The cache can therefore contain KV states from different denoising steps. Once the chunk is complete, the generator performs a clean forward pass over the assembled output at timestep 0 0 , refreshing the KV states of all tokens regardless of their acceptance steps. Subsequent chunks thus attend to history states computed from the completed clean output.
paragraphs.zh: 在每个块内，被接受的词元保留其被接受步骤时所计算的逐层键值，而活跃词元则随着去噪的继续更新各自的键值。 因此，缓存中可能同时包含来自不同去噪步骤的 KV 状态。 一旦该块完成，生成器会在时间步 0 0 对组装好的输出执行一次干净的前向传播，刷新所有词元的 KV 状态，而不论其被接受的步骤为何。 这样，后续块便可以基于由已完成的干净输出计算得到的历史状态进行注意力计算。

paragraphs.en: We apply spatiotemporal smoothing to each verifier’s score map before thresholding at every verification step. Spatial smoothing uses a normalized 9 × 9 9\times 9 Gaussian kernel with a standard deviation of 1.0 token and reflect padding, applied independently to each latent frame. paragraphs.zh: 在每个验证步骤进行阈值化之前，我们对每个验证器的分数图应用时空平滑。 空间平滑使用归一化的 9 × 9 9\times 9 高斯核，标准差为 1.0 个 token，并采用反射填充，对每个潜在帧独立应用。 时间平滑随后在同一个分块内，对当前及后续潜在帧的分数进行平均，使用标准差为 1.0 个潜在帧的高斯权重。

All baselines use the same applicable execution optimizations for fair throughput comparisons.

paragraphs.en: We follow VBench ( Huang et al., 2023 ) for 5-second videos and VBench-Long ( Huang et al., 2024 ) for 30-second videos for LongLive, reporting all 16 dimensions. For Lingbot-World 2.0, we aggregate six quality dimensions using VBench’s official normalization and weights, excluding temporal flickering because intended camera motion can produce frame-to-frame pixel changes. Following Reward Forcing ( Lu et al., 2025 ) , we measure Drift as the standard deviation of imaging-quality scores across non-overlapping 2-second segments, averaged over videos. We use VBench’s MUSIQ model and preprocessing, with 7 complete segments per Lingbot evaluation and 15 segments per 30-second LongLive evaluation. Lower Drift indicates more consistent imaging quality over time.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 LongLive，我们遵循 VBench（Huang 等，2023）对 5 秒视频和 VBench-Long（Huang 等，2024）对 30 秒视频的规定，报告全部 16 个维度。 对于 Lingbot-World 2.0，我们按照 VBench 的官方归一化方式和权重聚合六个质量维度，排除时间闪烁维度，因为有意的镜头运动会导致逐帧像素变化。 遵循 Reward Forcing（Lu 等，2025），我们将 Drift 定义为各不重叠的 2 秒片段成像质量分数的标准差，并在视频上取平均。 我们使用 VBench 的 MUSIQ 模型和预处理流程，每次 Lingbot 评估使用 7 个完整片段，每次 30 秒的 LongLive 评估使用 15 个片段。 Drift 越低表示成像质量随时间变化越稳定。

paragraphs.en: For Lingbot-World 2.0, we measure relative pose error (RPE) against the commanded ground-truth camera trajectory. We recover camera poses using Depth Anything 3 ( Lin et al., 2025 ) and apply Sim3 Umeyama alignment to the commanded trajectory independently for each of the five camera-control segments, yielding 1,000 segments across 200 videos. We compare relative transformations between consecutive frames. Rot is the mean angular error over all frame pairs, in degrees. Trans is the sum of translation errors divided by the sum of commanded displacements over all pairs, and is dimensionless. This protocol evaluates local camera-following accuracy under the same reconstruction and alignment procedure for all methods.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 Lingbot-World 2.0，我们针对指令给定的相机真实轨迹测量相对位姿误差（RPE）。 我们使用 Depth Anything 3（Lin et al., 2025）恢复相机位姿，并针对五个相机控制段中的每一段，独立地将估计位姿与指令轨迹进行 Sim3 Umeyama 对齐，从而在 200 个视频上共得到 1,000 个段。 我们比较相邻帧之间的相对变换。 Rot 是所有帧对上的平均角度误差，单位为度。 Trans 是平移误差之和除以所有帧对上指令位移之和，为无量纲量。 该评测流程在相同的重建与对齐流程下评估所有方法的局部相机跟随精度。

paragraphs.en: We construct a fixed benchmark of 200 scenes for Lingbot-World 2.0, each consisting of an initial image, a text prompt, and a camera trajectory. All methods use the same conditioning inputs and sampling seeds. Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct ( Qwen et al., 2025 ) generates scene descriptions spanning diverse categories and visual styles, and Z-Image-Turbo ( Image Team et al., 2026 ) generates the initial images at 1376 × 768 1376\times 768 . The image and video models receive the same scene prompt, combining environment, subject, and perspective descriptions. After fixing the benchmark, we construct the verifier’s training set from separate scenes using the same pipeline, filtering potential overlap through text and image similarity. Each video contains 253 frames, with the 252 camera transitions divided into five consecutive control segments of lengths 50, 50, 50, 50, and 52. For each segment, we uniformly sample an action from forward, backward, strafe left, strafe right, yaw left, yaw right, and stop, excluding the preceding segment’s action. Across the benchmark, this produces 593 translation, 276 rotation, and 131 stationary segments. Translation speeds are sampled from 𝒰 ⁡ ( 0.2 , 1.0 ) \mathcal{U}(0.2,1.0) , with the fastest translation segment in each video set to 1.0 1.0 to match the model’s per-video translation normalization. Yaw rates are sampled from 𝒰 ⁡ ( 0.6 , 2.0 ) \mathcal{U}(0.6,2.0) degrees per frame. We choose the lower bound based on preliminary tests in which smaller commands produced little visible rotation. Camera intrinsics follow the official adapter defaults and remain fixed across methods.
paragraphs.zh: 我们为 Lingbot-World 2.0 构建了一个包含 200 个场景的固定基准，每个场景由一张初始图像、一个文本提示词和一条相机轨迹组成。 所有方法均使用相同的条件输入和采样种子。 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct（Qwen et al., 2025）生成涵盖多样化类别与视觉风格的场景描述，Z-Image-Turbo（Image Team et al., 2026）以 1376 × 768 1376\times 768 的分辨率生成初始图像。 图像模型和视频模型接收相同的场景提示词，其中结合了环境、主体和视角描述。 在固定基准之后，我们使用相同的流程从单独的场景构建验证器的训练集，并通过文本和图像相似度过滤潜在的重叠。 每个视频包含 253 帧，其中 252 个相机转场被划分为五个连续的控制段，长度分别为 50、50、50、50 和 52。 对于每个控制段，我们从前进、后退、左移、右移、左转、右转和停止中均匀采样一个动作，且排除上一个控制段的动作。 在整个基准上，这产生了 593 个平移控制段、276 个旋转控制段和 131 个静止控制段。 平移速度从 𝒰 ⁡ ( 0.2 , 1.0 ) \mathcal{U}(0.2,1.0) 中采样，并将每个视频中速度最快的平移控制段设为 1.0 1.0，以匹配模型的逐视频平移归一化。 偏航角速度从每帧 𝒰 ⁡ ( 0.6 , 2.0 ) \mathcal{U}(0.6,2.0) 度中采样。 我们根据初步测试确定下界，在初步测试中更小的指令几乎不产生可见的旋转。 相机内参遵循官方适配器的默认设置，并在所有方法中保持固定。

paragraphs.en: The latent-based signals support our training-free design. Redundancy is available at the first step but becomes less useful as a token is refined, while stability is stronger afterwards yet undefined at the first step. paragraphs.en: The achievable acceleration depends on both the underlying generator and the difficulty of the generation domain. If the backbone is sensitive to reducing denoising steps, fewer tokens can be accepted early without degrading generation quality, which limits the attainable speedup. Similarly, more challenging domains may require additional refinement across a larger fraction of tokens. This is evident in world generation, where large viewpoint changes introduce stronger distortions than standard video generation and result in higher mean denoising steps, as shown in Table 3 . Our method therefore does not guarantee the same acceleration across different generators or domains.
paragraphs.zh: 可实现的加速效果取决于底层生成器和生成领域的难度。 如果主干对减少去噪步数较为敏感，那么在早期可被接受的词元数量就会减少且不降低生成质量，这限制了可达到的加速效果。 类似地，更具挑战性的领域可能需要对更大比例的词元进行额外细化。 这在世界生成中尤为明显，如 Table 3 所示，较大的视点变化比标准视频生成引入更强的畸变，并导致更高的平均去噪步数。 因此，我们的方法并不能保证在不同生成器或不同领域中都能获得相同的加速效果。

paragraphs.en: Our experiments focus on general video generation and world modeling, but token-wise commitment may be particularly effective when much of the target content is already constrained by available conditions. In talking-head generation ( Huang et al., 2026 ) , for example, the background can remain largely unchanged while motion is concentrated around the face and upper body. In environment-grounded world models such as Seoul World Model ( Seo et al., 2026 ) and World Observer ( Choi et al., 2026 ) , warped scene observations and reference images provide visual evidence for parts of the target view, while uncovered regions require new content to be generated. Dexterous World Models ( Kim et al., 2025 ) provide static scene renderings along the camera trajectory and generate interaction-induced changes while preserving unaffected content.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的实验聚焦于通用视频生成与世界建模，但当目标内容的很大一部分已被可用条件约束时，逐 token 的提交机制可能尤为有效。 例如，在说话人生成（Huang et al., 2026）中，背景可以基本保持不变，而运动集中在面部和上半身。 在 Seoul World Model（Seo et al., 2026）和 World Observer（Choi et al., 2026）等以环境为基础的世界模型中， warped 的场景观测与参考图像为目标视角的部分区域提供了视觉证据，而未被覆盖的区域则需要生成新内容。 Dexterous World Models（Kim et al., 2025）沿相机轨迹提供静态场景渲染，并在保留未受影响内容的同时生成由交互引起的变化。

paragraphs.en: These settings offer opportunities to allocate denoising computation according to how much refinement remains after conditioning. Tokens already reproducing content supported by scene conditions or references may be accepted early, while newly generated or dynamically changing regions receive further refinement. Extending token-wise commitment to these settings could also support efficient augmented and virtual reality applications that combine known environments with generated content and interaction dynamics.

sents.zh: 将逐词元承诺扩展到这些设置，还可以支持高效的增强现实与虚拟现实应用，这些应用将已知环境与生成内容及交互动态相结合。
